title: Minkowski content of a finite convex union
statement: Let $n,m\ge0$ and let $C_1,\ldots,C_m$ be closed convex subsets of $\mathbb R^n$, each with nonempty interior, that are pairwise disjoint. Then the Gaussian Minkowski content of their union equals the Gaussian surface area of their union.
